name: Activity
description: All events that happen within Backoffice are tracked and stored in the activities collection. This gives you full accountability over everything that happens.

operations.description: Returns a list of activity actions.

query.name: fields
query.description: Control what fields are being returned in the object.

query.name: limit
query.description: A limit on the number of objects that are returned.

query.name: meta
query.description: What metadata to return in the response.

query.name: offset
query.description: How many items to skip when fetching data.

query.name: sort
query.description: How to sort the returned items. `sort` is a CSV of fields used to sort the fetched items. Sorting defaults to ascending (ASC) order but a minus sign (` - `) can be used to reverse this to descending (DESC) order. Fields are prioritized by their order in the CSV. You can also use a ` ? ` to sort randomly.

query.name: filter
query.description: Select items in collection by given conditions.

query.name: search
query.description: Filter by items that contain the given search query in one of their fields.

operations.description: Retrieves the details of an existing activity action. Provide the primary key of the activity action and Backoffice will return the corresponding information.

query.name: fields
query.description: Control what fields are being returned in the object.

query.name: meta
query.description: What metadata to return in the response.

data.user_agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10_15_1) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML,like Gecko) Chrome/78.0.3904.108 Safari/537.36

user.description: The user who performed this action.

ip.description: The IP address of the user at the time the action took place.

user_agent.description: User agent string of the browser the user used when the action took place.
user_agent.example: Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10_15_1) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML,like Gecko) Chrome/78.0.3904.108 Safari/537.36

origin.description: Origin of the request when the action took place.

collection.description: Collection identifier in which the item resides.

item.description: Unique identifier for the item the action applied to. This is always a string, even for integer primary keys.

comment.description: User comment. This will store the comments that show up in the right sidebar of the item edit page in the admin app.

total_count.description: Returns the total item count of the collection you're querying.

filter_count.description: Returns the item count of the collection you're querying, taking the current filter/search parameters into account.
